material.description: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, §§1.1–1.3 “Chemistry in Context”, “Phases and Classification of Matter”, and “Physical and Chemical Properties” (https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/1-1-chemistry-in-context; https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/1-2-phases-and-classification-of-matter; https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/1-3-physical-and-chemical-properties): §1.1 frames chemistry around composition and properties of matter; §1.2 classifies pure substances as elements or compounds and distinguishes mixtures; §1.3 describes physical and chemical properties. Together these passages support the Claim’s introductory classification and composition/property framing.
